meta.notes: **Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out in desktop Chromium at https://www.oldtimeradiodownloads.com/. `ins.adsbygoogle` matched one visible 160×600 ad slot; cookie and app-banner selectors matched 0. `recipes/fixtures/old-time-radio-downloads/desktop-live-selector.html` is a minimal fixture for the observed selector, not a page capture. Other routes and locales were not checked.
